scope: Six fixed AgentBench-OS adaptations, three trials each. Same dataset, tool catalog, and budget settings as public-search-initial; different model and provider. Not an official benchmark or evidence of general model superiority.
cost_note: Sum of returned per-response usage costs. The pre-inference 429 trial reported no usage; connectivity smoke tests are excluded. Account spend counters may lag.

failure_analysis.detail: One trial hit DeepInfra HTTP 429 engine_overloaded before any MCP call. It remains in the 18-trial denominator.
One trial answered 122 after receiving all 124 paths in a complete glob response.
One trial calculated the correct count of 83 but included explanatory prose before the JSON. The frozen prompt requires only a JSON object.

methodology_note: The DeepInfra smoke passed before this fixed 18-trial run. Earlier Fireworks attempts were blocked by rate limits. Smoke/connection probes are not benchmark trials. No prompts or graders were tuned and no failed trials were replaced or rerun.
